news.title: Dividend of ₹5.50 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹5.50 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 6th August 2026 Payment date: 23rd September 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.3%, which is lower than the industry average of 0.6%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (21% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (18% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 15% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 52% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: LUMAXTECH: Joint Venture Stake Sale Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have maintained the price target for Lumax Auto Technologies at ₹2,271. Small adjustments to discount rate, revenue growth and profit margin assumptions were largely offset by a slightly higher future P/E multiple of 34.49x, compared with 33.59x earlier.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹40.91 (up from ₹26.08 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹49.2b (up 35% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.79b (up 57% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.7% (up from 4.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 8.7%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 38% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 71% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
